RTS

    SKIP 75                         \ grind: the 15 restores that stood here (5 bytes each) wrote back what was already there (see below); padding, so everything after keeps its address
.restore_game_zp
    \ grind: restore_game_zp restores only what the renderer's own work changes and the logic then reads. Nothing between
    \ save_game_zp and here writes &02 &03 &7E &7F &80 &82 &83 &84 &8E &8F &94 &95 &9B (tools/zplive.mjs, 2026-10-22,
    \ with its restoring range corrected; static scan of every render-phase store), and &00/&01 are put back by
    \ render's buffer_to_view (slot 2), the last writer of them, from the values view_to_buffer took at the start.
candidates.summary: Drop all 15 restores in this window (zp_save+0..11, +14, +15, +16 to &00 &01 &02 &03 &7E &7F &80 &82 &83 &84 &8E &8F &94 &95 &9B): each writes back the value already in the byte, since the renderer never changes it or, for &00/&01, buffer_to_view slot 2 has just put it back. The 75 bytes become padding before the label so every later bank-4 address is unchanged. Candidates 2 and 3 are alternatives to this one.
candidates.equivalence: restore_game_zp stores back, at the end of render, bytes save_game_zp saved at its start. For &02 &03 &7E &7F &80 &82 &83 &84 &8E &8F &94 &95 &9B the store writes the value already there, because nothing between save_game_zp (render, after wait_for_flip) and restore_game_zp writes them. Static: every instruction that stores to zero page in the render phase was scanned (render.6502, render_*.6502, sky*.6502, kindcache*.6502, scroll_hazel.6502, prebuild.6502 [runs before save_game_zp anyway], compiled_*.6502 and sprite_*.6502 [only STA (&C0),Y / (&C2),Y, STA &C2/&C3 and PLAYER_SAVE absolute], lib/*): none stores to, increments, shifts or TSB/TRBs any of the 13 by name or address (the only hits are render_zp.6502's own restores, and shield.6502/shield_hi.6502's logic-side writes to lives, player_y_velocity, player_jump_direction, player_firing_cooldown, which render never calls; render only reads lives at the lives digit). No zero-page-indexed stores (ST* &NN,X/Y) exist in any render-phase file. The game.6502 routines the render phase calls (check_if_mover_is_on_screen, move_to_next_column, calculate_screen_addresses_for_mover_on_edge, add/subtract_delta_to_screen_address_in_AX) write only &79, &B7, &CD, &CE/&CF, &D0, &D1 and the mover tables. Dynamic: tools/zplive.mjs rerun 2026-10-22 on build/strykers.ssd (8000 frames, seed 1, 2779 renders, with the 'restoring' PC range corrected to restore_game_zp..zero_render_vars, since write_column now sits above restore_game_zp and the original range swallowed the whole renderer) lists every zero-page address written during render: of this window's addresses only &00 and &01 appear. The interrupt (irq1_handler, sfx_tick) writes only field_count &90, game_over_cooldown &96, irq_accumulator &FC and its own non-zero-page variables, so no interrupt update to these bytes was being overwritten by the old restore. The removed pairs touch only A (LDA sets N and Z; the next instruction, LDA zp_save + 17, sets A, N, Z afresh) and no X, Y, C or V; A is reloaded by every following LDA. zp_save is read by nothing but render_zp.6502 and zeroed by zero_render_vars. restore_game_zp is entered only by render's JMP restore_game_zp (grep: no 'restore_game_zp +' entries). For &00 and &01 (screen_start_address_low/high): the only stores to them in the render phase are buffer_to_view's and history_to_view's (render.6502 lines 291, 293, 310, 312; no raw STA &00/&01 anywhere else outside render_zp.6502 and the logic). render does JSR view_to_buffer with X=2 straight after save_game_zp, with &00/&01 still holding the saved values, and the last write to them is buffer_to_view with X=2 at .scrolled (unconditional, after the pending-scroll loop that uses history_to_view), which stores buf_ss_lo/hi+2, i.e. those same values; view_to_buffer with X=2 is called only there (render_reset's each_screen loop covers X=1 and 0), and nothing after .scrolled (view_to_buffer back, put_on, the compiled kinds, the sky code) stores to &00/&01. So &00/&01 already hold the saved values when restore_game_zp runs, the same argument as the existing comment gives for &B2/&B3/&BA/&BB. Layout: the label moves up 75 bytes and the straight-line tail (LDA zp_save+17 / STA &9F onward) ends at exactly the address it had, so nothing after it moves; restore_game_zp is reached by an absolute JMP, no page cost.
candidates.relies_on: No page crossing moves: render at &9000+PAD_START is a SKIP-fixed origin, and the padding keeps render_bss_zero, shield.6502 and sky_off.6502 at their addresses. The routine is straight-line (no branches, no indexed reads). Relies on the zero-page analysis above and on nothing but render_zp.6502 reading zp_save.
